sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Copper scrap can be refined into Copper in a Smelter.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
Copper scrap is obtained by destroying certain structures or building pieces in the Mistlands, including the following:
• Dvergr wall lanterns found in Dvergr structures
• Dvergr barrels found in Dvergr structures
• Ancient swords and Ancient armor

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Like other metals, Copper scrap cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.
• Copper scrap is very similar to copper ore, though copper scrap can only be found in the Mistlands and is not acquired through mining deposits.
• In the case of Ancient swords/armor, there is a 50% chance to get copper scrap when mining a node, the other drop being Scrap iron.

full_text:
Copper scrap

Type: Ore | Internal ID: CopperScrap | Source: Dropped by breaking some Dvergr structures | Ancient swords/armor | Usage: Smelting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

Introduction. Copper scrap can be refined into Copper in a Smelter.

Availability. Copper scrap is obtained by destroying certain structures or building pieces in the Mistlands, including the following:
• Dvergr wall lanterns found in Dvergr structures
• Dvergr barrels found in Dvergr structures
• Ancient swords and Ancient armor

Notes. • Like other metals, Copper scrap cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.
• Copper scrap is very similar to copper ore, though copper scrap can only be found in the Mistlands and is not acquired through mining deposits.
• In the case of Ancient swords/armor, there is a 50% chance to get copper scrap when mining a node, the other drop being Scrap iron.
